seoTitle: Timeline Maker: Dated Events on a Line (SVG)
metaDescription: Enter events as date, title and description to draw a horizontal or vertical timeline, evenly spaced or to scale. Free SVG.
intro: Places dated events on a line with their titles and descriptions. Dates can be a year, a year-month or a full day.
why:
A timeline turns a list of dates into a story. Paste the events and get a clean line, alternating above and below to avoid overlap.

Even spacing keeps the text readable; to scale shows the real gaps, which is more honest but crowds close events. Dates are sorted for you. The event table below the image gives a text version.
howTo: Write one event per line: date | title | description.
Choose horizontal or vertical, even or to scale.

faq.a: YYYY, YYYY-MM and YYYY-MM-DD, with / allowed in full dates.
Years from -999 are accepted for the year form.
Long descriptions are limited to a few lines.
